key.name: language
key.description: Tesseract language codes joined with '+', for example 'eng+tam'.

key.name: tessdata-dir
key.description: Folder holding custom .traineddata files. Empty uses tesseract's default.

key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts text extraction. Empty disables it.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the panel indicator.
